Step 1: Load data
```{r}
# Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# Load gene names
geneNames <- read.csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")

# Load covariate data
covar <- read.csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")

# Load gene expression data
geneExpression <- read.csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv") |>
  column_to_rownames("X")

# Check dimensions
dim(covar)
dim(geneExpression)
```

Step 2: Match the data
```{r}
# Step 2: Match gene expression data with covariate data

biomarker <- t(geneExpression)

biomarker <- biomarker[covar$geoID, ]

# Check dimensions
dim(biomarker)

# Check if samples match
all(rownames(biomarker) == covar$geoID)
```
Step 3: Select the three genes
```{r}
selecgenes <- c("SSTR3", "CNR1", "NFYC")

geneNames %>%
  filter(GENE %in% selecgenes)

```
Step 4: Add selected genes to covariate data
```{r}
for (i in 1:length(selecgenes)) {
  
  probe <- geneNames$PROBEID[geneNames$GENE == selecgenes[i]]
  
  covar[[selecgenes[i]]] <- biomarker[, as.character(probe)]
  
}

dim(covar)

```

Step 5: Prepare the covariates
```{r}
covar <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")

covar$mat_age_yrs <- as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_age_yrs))
covar$mat_BMI <- as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_BMI))
covar$mat_vitD <- as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_vitD))

covar$preg_preeclampsia <- sub(".*: ", "", covar$preg_preeclampsia)

covar$BMI_group <- ifelse(covar$mat_BMI < 25, "<25", ">=25")

table(covar$BMI_group)

```
Step 6: Prepare final dataset
```{r}
for (i in 1:length(selecgenes)) {
  probe <- geneNames$PROBEID[geneNames$GENE == selecgenes[i]]
  covar[[selecgenes[i]]] <- biomarker[, as.character(probe)]
}

cleandata <- covar[, c(
  "mat_age_yrs", "mat_BMI", "mat_vitD",
  "preg_preeclampsia", "BMI_group",
  selecgenes
)]

dim(cleandata)

```
Step 7: Create the summary statistics table
```{r}
summary_table <- cleandata %>%
  group_by(preg_preeclampsia) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Age_Mean = mean(mat_age_yrs, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_SD = sd(mat_age_yrs, na.rm = TRUE),
    BMI_Mean = mean(mat_BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
    BMI_SD = sd(mat_BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
    VitaminD_Mean = mean(mat_vitD, na.rm = TRUE),
    VitaminD_SD = sd(mat_vitD, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

summary_table
```
Step 8: BMI group summary
```{r}
bmi_table <- cleandata %>%
  group_by(preg_preeclampsia, BMI_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(preg_preeclampsia) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

bmi_table
```

 Step 9: Select 10 genes for heatmap
```{r}
heatmap_genes <- c(
  "SSTR3", "CNR1", "NFYC",
  "PTX3", "LINC00661", "PDCD7",
  "UNC13A", "SOCS5", "CCDC87", "HAUS4"
)

# Match genes to probe IDs
probe_ids <- geneNames$PROBEID[
  match(heatmap_genes, geneNames$GENE)
]

# Check that all genes are available
all(as.character(probe_ids) %in% colnames(biomarker))
```
Step 10: Create heatmap
```{r}

library(pheatmap)

# Prepare gene expression data
heatmap_data <- t(biomarker[, as.character(probe_ids)])
rownames(heatmap_data) <- heatmap_genes

# Add categorical variables
annotation <- data.frame(
  Preeclampsia = cleandata$preg_preeclampsia,
  BMI_Group = cleandata$BMI_group
)

rownames(annotation) <- rownames(biomarker)

# Create heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = annotation,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Gene Expression Heatmap"
)
```
Step 11:Calculate mean expression differences
```{r}
# Add pregnancy status to gene expression data
plot_data <- as.data.frame(t(heatmap_data))
plot_data$Preeclampsia <- cleandata$preg_preeclampsia

# Calculate mean expression for each gene
gene_means <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Preeclampsia) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(heatmap_genes), mean))

# Calculate differences between groups
gene_diff <- data.frame(
  Gene = heatmap_genes,
  Difference = as.numeric(gene_means[gene_means$Preeclampsia == "Preeclampsia", -1]) -
               as.numeric(gene_means[gene_means$Preeclampsia == "Normal", -1])
)

gene_diff
```
Step 13: Create the lollipop plot
```{r}
ggplot(gene_diff, aes(x = Difference, y = reorder(Gene, Difference))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = Difference,
                   yend = reorder(Gene, Difference)),
               color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Difference > 0), size = 4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "hotpink", "FALSE" = "cornflowerblue"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Higher in Normal",
               "TRUE" = "Higher in Preeclampsia"),
    name = "Expression"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene Expression Differences by Pregnancy Status",
    x = "Mean Expression Difference (Preeclampsia - Normal)",
    y = "Gene"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
Step 14: Circular bar plot
```{r}

gene_diff$Gene <- factor(
  gene_diff$Gene,
  levels = gene_diff$Gene
)

ggplot(gene_diff,
       aes(x = Gene, y = abs(Difference),
           fill = Difference > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  coord_polar() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "hotpink",
               "FALSE" = "cornflowerblue"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Higher in Normal",
               "TRUE" = "Higher in Preeclampsia"),
    name = "Expression"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene Expression Differences by Pregnancy Status",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Absolute Mean Expression Difference"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )



```
